snippet.title: Iron Valiant Art Preview
snippet.description:
Hello everyone, this is long overdue. This is a snippet of progress we have made on the art and level design side for our game Iron Valiant. You can find the rest of the details and the update article at our indieDB page. We hope you enjoy the visuals! We worked very hard to make this pleasing.

IndieDB update article for our game
https://www.indiedb.com/games/iron-valiant/news/iron-valiant-progress-update-2
